name: PayPal_Login_Phishing
author: doyun
description: PayPal 로그인 및 계정 인증을 사칭하는 피싱 페이지 탐지 (강화 버전)

eq: match text "paypal" AND match text "your account has been limited" AND match text "verify your identity"
match text "paypal" AND match text "confirm your account" AND match text "password"
match text "paypal" AND match text "verify your account" AND match text "payment information"
match text "paypal" AND match text "account has been limited" AND match text "login"
match text "paypal" AND match text "secure your account" AND match text "update your information"
match text "paypal" AND (match text "unusual activity" OR match text "suspicious activity") AND match text "verify"
match text "paypal" AND match text "account suspension" AND match text "login to resolve"
match text "paypal" AND match text "we need to confirm" AND match text "billing information"
